name: Apigee Extras Views
description: Submodule of Apigee Extras that exposes Apigee developer apps to Views via an apigee_app base table, a field handler, and a query plugin loading apps from Apigee Edge storage.
project_description: Apigee Extras Views is a submodule of Apigee Extras. It implements hook_views_data() to register an apigee_app Views base table and provides two Views plugins: an apigee_app_field field handler and an apigee_app_query query plugin. The query plugin loads developer_app entities from Apigee Edge and maps their name, display name, status, developer email, description and creation date onto Views result rows, so site builders can list Apigee developer apps through the standard Views UI without custom code.
